2610.04196.title: Asynchronous Is Nearly Free for Evolution Strategies on Long-Horizon Agentic Tasks
2610.04196.paper_summary: LLM-based long-horizon agentic post-training is often bottlenecked by rollout generation: trajectories span many interaction turns, completion times vary substantially, and synchronous update barriers leave faster workers waiting for stragglers. Asynchronous reinforcement learning which has been adopted in LLM post-training addresses this inefficiency by consuming trajectories as they arrive, but introduces policy lag and off-policy optimization. Evolution strategies (ES) offer a backpropagation-free alternative for LLM post-training, yet it relies on a larger number of rollouts and existing practices have remained largely synchronous. In this short-form paper, we introduce bounded-staleness asynchronous ES and demonstrate it on Endless Terminals benchmark using Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct. Across three evaluation seeds, natural Async-1 matches synchronous ES, achieving 25.9\% versus 25.4\% held-out success. Controlled schedules that delay 10\% of each update cohort by four or eight policy updates reduce success by only 1.6 and 3.1 percentage points, respectively, without explicit off-policy correction. GRPO performs better overall, reaching 29.0\% held-out success, but importantly our results show that ES tolerates moderate policy staleness with limited degradation, opening possibilities for future improvement of ES-based post-training with asynchronous algorithms. To the best of our knowledge, we are the first to demonstrate the effectiveness of sync and async ES on a multi-turn terminal style agentic coding task.
2610.04196.paper_summary_zh: LLM 基於長期代理的後訓練常常受到回滾生成的瓶頸限制：軌跡跨越許多互動回合，完成時間差異顯著，且同步更新障礙使得更快的工作者需要等待落後者。已在 LLM 後訓練中採用的非同步強化學習通過在軌跡到達時進行消耗來解決這一低效問題，但引入了策略延遲和非策略優化。進化策略（ES）為 LLM 後訓練提供了一種無需反向傳播的替代方案，但它依賴於更多的回滾，且現有做法仍然主要是同步的。在這篇短文中，我們介紹了有界陳舊非同步 ES，並在使用 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct 的 Endless Terminals 基準上進行了演示。在三個評估種子中，自然的 Async-1 與同步 ES 匹配，達到 25.9\% 對比 25.4\% 的保留成功率。控制的時間表將每個更新小組的 10\% 延遲四次或八次策略更新，成功率僅分別減少 1.6 和 3.1 個百分點，且無需明確的非策略修正。GRPO 整體表現更佳，達到 29.0\% 的保留成功率，但重要的是，我們的結果顯示 ES 能夠容忍適度的策略陳舊，且降級有限，這為未來使用非同步算法改進基於 ES 的後訓練開啟了可能性。據我們所知，我們是第一個在多回合終端風格的代理編碼任務上展示同步和非同步 ES 效能的研究。
